integrity: Full domain is established by analytic density extremization; symbolic and numerical checking is supplementary, and does not certify an infinite family by enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the first Chesneau (2024) trivariate polynomial-power family, for integer \(m\ge1\) and real \(\theta\ge0\). No inference, tail-dependence, or noninteger-exponent claim. Priority relative to unindexed literature remains unresolved.
title: Sharp parity-dependent admissibility for polynomial-power trivariate copulas
